summary: Closed the non-owner boundary of the recovery-authority finding on the corrected-alias receipt c342db60ffff4e42889bf53646049491 (successor of the alias-pinning revision): the below-ballot attempt by replica 1 is violated with witness 12 (ballot 6 against peers storing 7, no matching reply, no dispatch, no follow-up message) and the above-ballot attempt by replica 3 holds at index 17 (ballot 8 joined by the peers, two matching replies, phase-1 dispatch), so the account no longer carries a pending comparison and the gate is measured on both sides of the boundary. The superseded receipt c68b6de1442e45ffa00ddaf4df9b32e6 is retained in the account together with the cause of its unknown control (unpinned round-start prerequisite aliases), and both supporting behaviors now cite the corrected receipt alongside the owner-case and value-adoption indices. All four registered questions remain explained, with the value-adoption defect and its completed agreement contradiction, the recovery-authority boundary, the status-guard per-attempt stall, and the holds account for the client-completion protection, each grounded in retained receipts; remaining limits in the accounts concern the single configuration and instance exercised, the harness's explicit delivery and direct entry-point calls, and the absence of a client or executor in these runs.
